# 💳 Feedback Form (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — a step-by-step recipe that creates a Google Form (`gws forms forms create` with a title), grabs the responder URL from the response, and emails it to the respondents. The only Google Forms fiche in the catalog. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the recipe assumes the gws-forms and gws-gmail utility skills are loaded and the gws binary is installed and authenticated; it creates a bare form with a title — adding questions, sections and validation is on you or the agent afterwards. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
